description: Close-up photograph of a printed Bible page open to the passage headed 'The Armor of God' (Ephesians 6:10-12). The verses about putting on the full armor of God and struggling against spiritual forces of wickedness are in sharp focus; surrounding text is blurred. Attached to Q post 3914 as Armor_of_God.jpg.
text: The Armor of God. 10 Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of His might. 11 Put on the full armor of God, so that you will be able to stand firm against the schemes of the devil. 12 For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the powers, against the world forces of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

description: Meme titled 'The Plan' pairing a black-and-white portrait photograph of Henry Kissinger with a quotation attributed to him about Americans welcoming U.N. troops and world government if threatened. The caption attributes the quote to an address at the Bilderberg meeting at Evian, France, May 21, 1992. Attached to Q posts 3916 and 4003.
text: The Plan. 'Today Americans would be outraged if U.N. troops entered Los Angeles to restore order; tomorrow they will be grateful! This is especially true if they were told there was an outside threat from beyond whether real or promulgated, that threatened our very existence. It is then that all peoples of the world will pledge with world leaders to deliver them from this evil. The one thing every man fears is the unknown. When presented with this scenario, individual rights will be willingly relinquished for the guarantee of their well being granted to them by their world government.' - Henry Kissinger in an address to the Bilderberg meeting at Evian, France, May 21, 1992.
flags: The quotation is widely considered apocryphal/unverified — no transcript of the 1992 Bilderberg meeting confirms Kissinger said this; the meme presents it as fact

description: Header graphic composed of a grid of dozens of blurred portrait photographs of missing children and young people, overlaid with the large white word 'MISSING'. Watermarked TheFreeThoughtProject.com, indicating it accompanied an article on missing persons from that site. Referenced by Q post 392 as missing.jpg.
flags: The individual portraits are blurred and unidentifiable; many appear to be minors and are left unnamed

description: Movie-poster-style QAnon digital artwork in red and black. A stylized portrait of Donald Trump dominates the left, with the U.S. Capitol dome, Washington Monument and presidential seal in the background. Text declares 'The Hunt Is On' and 'Hunters Become The Hunted — Patriots In Control', dedicating the piece to Trump, the 'Q-Team', and anons of the Great Awakening; signed with a 'Cross & Country' artist logo. Attached to Q post 3923.
text: BELOW THE DEPTHS OF THE D.C. SWAMP. THE HUNT IS ON. In the invisible war for the future of our Republic, the tables are now turned. And now, the... HUNTERS BECOME THE HUNTED. PATRIOTS IN CONTROL. IN HONOR OF DONALD J. TRUMP, Q-TEAM PATRIOTS, ALL ANONS & EVERY MEMBER OF THE GREAT AWAKENING ENGAGED IN THE HUNT. WWG1WGA! ENJOY THE SHOW! CROSS & COUNTRY
flags: Propaganda-style fan artwork asserting the QAnon 'invisible war' narrative; the claims are the artwork's, not established fact

description: Screenshot of a tweet from the verified account Malik Obama (@ObamaMalik) posted April 5, 2020, consisting only of the hashtag #WWG1WGA and a photograph of a polished brass ship's bell engraved 'Where We Go One We Go All' (first letter partly obscured by reflection), sitting on a wooden deck. The bell photo matches the one QAnon lore associates with the phrase's claimed origin on a yacht. Attached to Q post 3924.
text: Malik Obama. @ObamaMalik. #WWG1WGA. WHERE WE GO ONE WE GO ALL. 5:28 AM · Apr 5, 2020 · Twitter for Android. 1.9K Retweets. 6.5K Likes

flags: The bell's provenance (often claimed to be from JFK's yacht) is not shown in the image and is unverified
